Mapping: (a) reboot - store_survives_restart_and_enforces_durable_floor + processor eviction_respects_durable_pin_and_floor reopen leg; (b) corruption - store_rejects_tamper_and_wrong_sealing_seed + store_refuses_pin_replacement_for_same_iid + processor corrupt_durable_record_fails_admission_closed (foreign-seed reopen = PersistenceError, no gradient entry); (c) rollback + exactly-one-side - store-level covered (store_rejects_state_rollback_and_heals_floor_lag, store_fails_closed_when_exactly_one_side_is_present); processor level NEW: rolled_back_durable_state_fails_admission_closed (sealed seq-100 snapshot restored over seq-200 behind the 200 floor: pinned_pubkey_for None, load = Err(Corrupt) exactly, seq 150 intermediate and seq 250 strictly-newer both PersistenceError, no gradient entry; snapshot restored with hardened 0600 per r2ns); (d) eviction interaction - eviction_respects_durable_pin_and_floor (durable pin binds and floor holds after eviction, restart leg included); (e) replay through authenticated relay after restart - the persist-first path validates the origin signature on every process(); the post-restart replay leg of eviction_respects_durable_pin_and_floor covers StaleSeqNum rejection via the durable floor. Style mirrors the sibling integration tests (unique_test_roots/remove_roots, reopen, raw-record mutation).
